description: Call this BEFORE parse_user_story. Finds what a careful tester would ask before writing tests: missing acceptance criteria, outcomes that can't be asserted, no user role, untestable words (fast, easy, many), limits without numbers, no failure path, missing preconditions, and (with context) terms the context never explains. Returns questions for a person to answer, each with why it matters and the words that raised it. If ready is false, ask the user these questions and wait; do not guess the answers.

context.description: Related product docs, glossary or notes; terms the story uses but this never explains become questions

name: review_user_story
title: Review user story before testing
